pages.title: One tablet every morning · 1/3
paragraphs: It is spring in Portland, and the air is full of pollen. Sofia sneezes all morning, and her eyes itch. She walks into a small pharmacy near her apartment. Behind the counter, a kind pharmacist is writing something. His name tag says Hank. He looks up and greets her with a smile.
“Good morning! Can I help you?” says Hank. “Yes. I sneeze a lot, and my eyes itch.” says Sofia. “It sounds like an allergy. Take one tablet every morning.” says Hank.
